stories.title: Joshua Van Set to Defend Flyweight Gold Against Manel Kape in UFC 336 Main Event
stories.excerpt: Joshua Van will look to defend his flyweight title for the third time at UFC 336 in Toronto against Manel Kape.
stories.context: UFC 336 has its main event. Joshua Van will defend his flyweight title against Manel Kape on January 30 at Scotiabank Arena in Toronto, Canada. The matchup was announced during the UFC 333 broadcast in Abu Dhabi. The 25-year-old champion has taken the division by storm. Van first made a statement when he accepted a short-notice fight against Brandon Royval and delivered a Fight of the Year-worthy performance. He eventually captured the flyweight title after then-champion Alexandre Pantoja suffered a freak injury just seconds into their fight.

stories.context: During Saturday’s UFC 336 broadcast, UFC officials announced the promotion’s return to Dallas, which will take place on January 16, 2027. No main event or other bouts were announced for what will be a Fight Night card at the American Airlines Center. The promotion has visited Dallas six times previously, most recently in 2022, when Julianna Pena and Amanda Nunes faced off for the second time. Nunes won the fight, which headlined UFC 277. Prior to that, 2018 saw Tyron Woodley vs. Darren Till headline UFC 228.
